limitations: Counts and exact ratios describe only supplied complete observed sample cases; no prevalence estimate or confidence interval.

All proposed dispositions, tool identities, source facts and human judgments remain supplied and unverified.
Supplied source/fact/profile and reviewer identities are not authenticated.
